name: DSH 证据协议技能包 / DSH Evidence Protocol Skills
description: 下结论前的六道关卡：度量自检、对照稳健性、事件级 R、证伪后落点清理、派生字段一致性、审计报告复核。 / Six gates before a conclusion: metric self-test, comparison robustness, event-level R, post-falsification cleanup, derived-field consistency, audit-report review.
longDescription:
## 中文

一个技能 `evidence-protocol`，内含 6 份逐字保留的协议正文（references/）：

1. 度量自检（正例/负例/数量级三关）
2. 对照稳健性（C1~C26）
3. 事件级 R 验证（真实出场 + 实测成本 + 四验）
4. 证伪后生产落点清理
5. 派生字段生命周期审计
6. 审计报告复核

## English

One skill `evidence-protocol` with six verbatim protocols under `references/`: metric self-test, comparison robustness (C1–C26), event-level R verification, post-falsification production cleanup, derived-field lifecycle audit, and audit-report review.
